text.bobin_craft.mode_enabled: §a[Bobin Craft] Bobin mode enabled. WASD: move; screen edges: pan. Exit: [Esc]
gui.bobin_craft.raid.title: Tactical deployment map
raid.bobin_craft.welcome: Welcome to the safe forest outpost. Use the planning table to deploy; press G for the top-down camera.
raid.bobin_craft.unavailable: The raid world is unavailable. Try again when the server has finished loading.
raid.bobin_craft.no_plan: No tactical deployment plan is available for this world.
raid.bobin_craft.unsafe: No safe deployment point was found. You remain at the outpost.
raid.bobin_craft.deployed: Deployment complete. Reach the marked landing-pad extraction and stand still for 5 seconds to return. Your inventory is preserved.
raid.bobin_craft.extract_hint: Extraction zone reached. Stand still for 5 seconds to return to the outpost.
raid.bobin_craft.extract_cancelled: Extraction cancelled: stay inside the marked zone and stand still.
raid.bobin_craft.extracted: Extraction complete. You and your inventory have returned to the outpost.
raid.bobin_craft.hub_blocked: The outpost return point is blocked. Clear the safe spawn area and try again.
gui.bobin_craft.tactical.title: Warzone field map
gui.bobin_craft.tactical.controls: Scroll: zoom · Drag: pan · %s / Esc: close
gui.bobin_craft.tactical.legend: Known landmarks · E: extraction · Navigate by terrain
raid.bobin_craft.hub_bed: Rest here; raid respawn remains at the outpost.
raid.bobin_craft.hub_boundary: The checkpoint is closed. Deploy using the planning table.
